india._readme: Headline indicators for the India Overview page. Every value below is real and sourced — no placeholders. Fields follow the schema in DATA_MODEL.md. 'year' is the year the data actually refers to, not the year it was published or accessed.

indicators.methodology_note: World Bank World Development Indicators, midyear estimate.
GDP at current US$ (nominal), World Bank World Development Indicators.
Latest available full Census figure; population aged 7 and above. The 2021 Census was delayed and has not yet produced an updated national literacy figure.
Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), Annual Report 2025 (calendar year), usual status (ps+ss), persons aged 15 years and above, all-India.
Life expectancy at birth, total, World Bank World Development Indicators.
Individuals using the Internet, % of population. World Bank / ITU World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database — most recent value published by World Bank at time of writing.
